hard_checks.label: Scenario and repeat counts are positive integers
Every scenario has the declared repeat set
Every trial exposes metrics, cost, latency, and call count
Trial metrics and operational values are finite
Published metric means recompute from trials
Published total cost recomputes from trials

disclosure_checks.label: Every non-error trial exposes every published metric
Confidence-interval keys match published metric keys
Every declared interval is finite and contains its mean
Mean per-trial cost reconciles within declared precision
Median latency reconciles within declared precision
Provider-error trials are counted and remain visible
Provider, requested/served model, and pinning are disclosed
